howItWorks.sectionSubtitle: Set it up once in minutes. After that, you just forward receipts.
howItWorks.step1Desc: Add each customer with their amount and due date: weekly, monthly or one-off. If you only want to log your sales, you can skip this step.
howItWorks.step2Desc: When a Yape or transfer arrives, forward the screenshot to Mercurio’s WhatsApp. Optionally type a short name like “lucia” to assign it instantly.
howItWorks.step3Desc: Mercurio reads the amount, date and operation number, records it and assigns it to the right payment. Each customer shows as paid, due soon or late.

faq.sectionSubtitle: Have another question? Message us on WhatsApp or email hello@mercuriohub.io.
faq.q1: How do I track the payments I receive by Yape and Plin?
faq.a1: You add each customer in Mercurio with their amount and due date. Whenever you receive a Yape, Plin or transfer, you forward the screenshot on WhatsApp. Mercurio reads the receipt, assigns it to the customer and updates their status: paid, due soon or late.
faq.q2: Do my customers need to install anything or sign up?
faq.a2: No. They pay as usual. Only you use Mercurio, by forwarding the receipts you already get.
faq.a3: Screenshots from Yape, Plin (BBVA, Interbank and Scotiabank), BCP transfers and Binance, as images or PDFs. You can send them on WhatsApp or upload them in the dashboard.
faq.q4: What if the receipt doesn’t show the customer’s name?
faq.a4: When you forward it, type the short name you set for that payment, for example “lucia”, and Mercurio assigns it there. If a payment stays unassigned, you assign it in one click from the dashboard.
faq.q5: What kind of business is it for?
faq.a5: Anyone who gets paid by many people: rentals, classes and academies, gyms, school fees, instalments or sales. Each payment can be weekly, monthly or one-off.
faq.q6: Do I need a credit card to start?
faq.a6: No. The Free plan never expires and needs no card. You only pay if you move to Pro, for S/29 a month. Payments are processed by Culqi and you can cancel at any time.
faq.a7: Each account’s data is isolated. Data is encrypted in transit and stored encrypted on AWS servers. We don’t share or sell your data.
faq.q8: Can I move my payments to Excel or Google Sheets?
faq.a8: Yes. Connect your Google account and export your payments to Google Sheets. From there you can download them as Excel.
